EmailTemplate.subject: ON THE FLY: 3 Tips for Your Travel Business to Emerge Stronger
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
As we prepare to flip the calendar to June, check out our latest takes from the travel world for client spotlights and more!
3 Tips for Your Travel Business to Emerge Stronger In times like this, our top priority is to weather the storm. But we must also make ourselves better prepared for the challenges to come and be ready to capitalize when the travel market comes roaring back. Read the blog <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/3-tips-to-emerge-stronger?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Flywire Client Spotlights
Nimmo Bay From heli-fishing to hot tubs, Nimmo Bay has an experience for everyone. Learn more about this unique resort, how they are responding to the COVID-19 restrictions on travel, and what they have planned for the future. Read the spotlight <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/client-spotlight-nimmo-bay?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Holiday Niseko Niseko attracts skiers and snowboarders from all over the world, and the Holiday Niseko team are experts in the best the area has to offer. We talked to Joel Westcot about their new refund policy, social media campaigns, and more. Read the spotlight <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/client-spotlight-holiday-niseko?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Elite Havens Elite Havens is Asia's market leader in high-end villa vacations. We caught up with Jon Stonham, CEO, about how he stays connected to guest feedback and why travelers who try a villa vacation rarely go back. Read the spotlight <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/client-spotlight-elite-havens?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
